description: This file defines the Store2 class, which implements multiple interfaces related to a persistent key-value store using SQLite. It includes methods for managing data, integrity checks, backups, and notifications within a plugin architecture.

classes.name: Store2
classes.description: A class implementing a persistent key-value store with SQLite, supporting data management, integrity, backup, and notification functionalities within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: A nested class within Store2 that dispatches value change notifications asynchronously.

methods.name: TempDirectoryCheck
methods.description: Checks and fixes issues with temporary directory and journal files.

methods.name: IntegrityCheck
methods.description: Performs an integrity check on the SQLite database and marks it as corrupt if needed.

methods.name: Backup
methods.description: Creates a backup of the database, handling corruption scenarios.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the SQLite database and initializes schema and triggers.

methods.name: IsTimeSynced
methods.description: Checks if the system time is synchronized, optionally using system manager.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for store events.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair in the store with optional TTL, notifying observers.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value and TTL for a given key.

methods.name: DeleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a specific key from the store.

methods.name: GetKeys
methods.description: Retrieves all keys within a namespace.

methods.name: SetNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Sets storage size limit for a namespace.

methods.name: GetNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Retrieves storage size limit for a namespace.
